profile.headline: Front-End Developer and Engineering Manager
profile.summary:
Web engineer. Advanced web interfaces in Javascript expert. Expert in client-side MVC frameworks such as AngularJS and web styling with HTML5/CSS3. JS frameworks developer and optimized UX supporter.

Backend web developer with frameworks such as Ruby on Rails and Python/Django.

Currently expanding knowledge towards web mobile development in iOS and Android.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Driving and supporting my team while building new cool things to make Airbnb stakeholders’ life easier!
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Team Leadership · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Operational Excellence · Client Development

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.locationName: Bahía de San Francisco y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description: Advanced interfaces web engineer with Javascript using MVC frameworks, mainly AngularJS. In charge of UX optimization and application frontend with HTML5 and CSS. Geeking and discovering a new world @ Yahoo! :D

positions.title: Frontend Engineer - JS/AngularJS Expert
positions.locationName: Bahía de San Francisco y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description: Advanced interfaces web engineer with Javascript using MVC frameworks, mainly AngularJS. In charge of UX optimization and application frontend with HTML5 and CSS. Currently reinforcing fullstack skills taking part in backend development using Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: FrontEnd Developer
positions.locationName: Bahía de San Francisco y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Using state-of-the-art technologies and latest developing methods to improve web & mobile user interfaces (such as HTML5, Responsive Design, WebApps, etc...).
Developing frameworks to speed up user interfaces creation and management, while keeping high quality and security standars.
We are following the cutting-edge design patterns to guarantee the best experience, not only to the end user, but the framework user, too.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Front-end development with XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, Jquery and JQueryUI.
Back-end development with PHP.
Facebook API development.
Knowledge and management of Content Management Systems (CMS), mainly Intelligenia's own CMS, "UniWeb CMS".

positions.title: Web development assistant
positions.description:
websites maintenance.
Web designing and web composition with CSS and HTML.
Facebook apps development with Fbml.
Intelligenia's web apps assistance in front-end development.

positions.title: Vice president of Communications area
positions.description:
Promotional Campaigns about products and projects AIESEC offers.
Target analysis in order to improve the results of the promotions.
Internal communications processes improvement into AIESEC Granada.
Promotion of AIESEC through traditional media.
Promotion of AIESEC through social media, planning and carrying out community management processes in the main social networks (twitter, facebook, linkedin, google+).
Promotional material design.
Team management in an association with more than 40 persons just in Granada
Time and human resources management.

positions.title: Researching scholarship
positions.description: Main developer (under monitoring) on “Associative Classification Algorithms: efficience study” Project, in the Data Mining researching field into the “Soft Computing and Intelligent Information Systems” Researching Group (Department of Computer Sciences and Artificial Intelligence, University of Granada).

volunteerExperiences.description:
Campañas promocionales sobre productos y proyectos que AIESEC ofrece.
Análisis de objetivos con el fin de mejorar los resultados en promociones.
Desarrollo y mejora de los procesos de comunicación interna dentro de AIESEC Granada.
Promoción de AIESEC a través de medios tradicionales de difusión.
Promoción de AIESEC a través de medios sociales, planeando y llevando a cabo procesos de "community management en las principales redes sociales (twitter, facebook, linkedin, google+).
Diseño de material promocional.
Organización de equipos en una asociación de más de 40 personas sólo en Granada.
Gestión de recursos humanos y temporales.
